name: dsh-connect-dumate
description: 把本机登录的百度搭子（DuMate）接入 DeepSeek Harness：模型直接进 DSH 的模型选择器，默认走云端模型网关（搭子 App 不用开着），积分余额、积分包、每日签到与近 7 天消耗作为只读读数显示在输入框胶囊里。
author: seacoral1223

scripts.test: node tests/adapter-offline.test.mjs && node tests/failure-codes.test.mjs && node tests/credits-parse.test.mjs && node tests/version-fence.test.mjs && node tests/lifecycle.test.mjs && node tests/coldstart.test.mjs && node tests/fresh-machine.test.mjs && node tests/foreign-machine.test.mjs && node tests/machine-variants.test.mjs && node tests/save-rollback.test.mjs && node tests/claim-dedup.test.mjs && node tests/client-structure.test.mjs && node tests/pill-visibility.test.mjs && node tests/defaults.test.mjs && node tests/disabled.test.mjs && node tests/manual-login.test.mjs && node tests/http-robustness.test.mjs && node tests/portable.test.mjs && node tests/structure.test.mjs
scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check client.js && node --check lib/adapter.js && node --check src/upstream.cjs && npm test

compatibility.note: 只在 DSH 0.2.2-rc.3（Windows）上实测过；区间按同机 bundle 的写法保守声明。
